message.content:
**Yunus is a rising American battle rapper from Prince George's County, Maryland, in the DMV area, known for transforming mockery of his African roots and family background into fuel for his rapid ascent in the scene.** With **28 catalogued battles amassing over 1.25 million views**, he has emerged as one of the most dangerous upcoming talents, earning endorsements from legends like Tay Roc and Daylyt.[1][2]

### Battle History
Yunus began honing his skills through high school freestyles and early influences like Conceited and Hitman, reigniting his passion in 2021 via Twitter Spaces before transitioning to major stages.[1] His career highlights include a high-profile **UK debut in December 2024 against Nigerian legend Slimbuck at Premier Battles in London's Hootananny Brixton**, where he delivered aggressive multis and personal shots, such as mocking Slimbuck's career views and continental status: "only in your continent are you top tier in the US you wouldn't even [be] my tier."[2][3] Other notable matchups feature **Franchise in an M2 event titled #THERIOT**, showcasing his DMV representation amid intense competition.[4] He has competed across platforms like Premier Battles and local leagues, building from online cyphers to international spots.[1][2]

### Notable Wins and Achievements
While specific win-loss records aren't fully detailed, Yunus's trajectory marks him as a "cleaner-upper" of competition, with his Slimbuck clash highlighting dominance through superior preparation—he "picked up everything" while his opponent deleted socials—and crowd reactions affirming his edge.[1][3] Legends' co-signs underscore his threat level, positioning him as a top upcoming prospect from the DMV.[1]

### Style
Yunus blends **raw skill, powerful African pride, and undeniable bars**, turning personal jabs—like laughs at his janitor father—into lethal rebuttals and multis.[1][3] His flows feature vivid storytelling, sacrifice-themed punches (e.g., "all those sacrifices your African dad made you're [a] disgrace"), and brash claims of superiority, delivered with high energy suited for live crowds.[1][3]

### Interviews and Appearances
A key documentary, **"Proudly African. Proudly Dangerous. The Rise of Yunus" (May 2025, GOAT STATUS on YouTube)**, chronicles his journey from ridicule to stardom, including early freestyles and Twitter Spaces origins.[1] Battle footage like Yunus vs. Slimbuck (Premier Battles) and Franchise vs. Yunus (#THERIOT) doubles as visual profiles of his live prowess.[3][4] Follow his updates via @itsjustyunus on socials.[1]
